notes.title: Eternal Dungeon Update v1.5.0!
notes.content:
Eternal Dungeon 1.5.0 Patch Notes October 10th, 2022

• Updated functionality: Jump + Attack is significantly more responsive now! You can now press both buttons at the same time for an instant jump attack! It may make some spots easier!

• Made a few small changes to the first 20% of level one to make it a bit easier for new players that are less experienced in this style of game.

In other news:

• Eternal Dungeon is now also available on the Google Play store for FREE! It will also be made available on iOS as well hopefully within the next few months!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MordiemEntertainment.EternalDungeon

Thank you so much for playing!
-Sal

notes.title: Eternal Dungeon Update v1.4.0!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

I noticed that most players are having difficulty beating levels, so I added checkpoints!

Each level has a checkpoint around halfway through, so I had to make some minor changes around those spots in order to accommodate them.

The checkpoints only persist while you are in a level. Once you exit a level, the checkpoints will reset.

Thank you so much for playing!
-Sal

notes.title: Eternal Dungeon Update v1.3.3!
notes.content:

Thank you so much for playing!
